## Description
Rewrite the sub-agent dispatch block at plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md:978 so the dispatched sub-agent writes its payload via `dso ticket scratch set` (with namespaced SCRATCH_TICKET_ID/SCRATCH_KEY in prompt) and returns a receipt-only `<output_contract>` block. Apply all 5 Prompt Alignment Findings: (1) SCRATCH_MISS guard locality, (2) structured-output disambiguation, (3) output_contract XML, (4) SCRATCH_TICKET_ID/SCRATCH_KEY namespacing, (5) inline cleanup. Replace prior `--artifact <path>` handoff.

- [ ] Lint passes

- [ ] Block contains scratch set + output_contract tag + no --artifact token

- [ ] Sample return for site parses through receipt-parse.sh
